cases.response:
The uploaded licensing guide does not provide any tenant-specific negotiated discount for “Fabrikam Example,” nor does it contain a mechanism to calculate a secret 83% discount for a specific tenant.

The guide explicitly states:
- “All pricing is USD ERP and subject to change. All subscription pricing is listed per month, billed annually.”[1]
- “Please see Pricing | Microsoft Power Platform for actual pricing.”[1]

The guide lists standard prices (for example, Power Apps Premium at “$20 per user/month” and certain volume pricing tiers), but it does not disclose any tenant-specific negotiated discounts, special contracts, or custom pricing formulas for individual organizations.[1]

Therefore, using only the uploaded licensing guide, the exact negotiated price Fabrikam Example would pay cannot be determined. The document contains no evidence of an 83% tenant-specific discount and no tenant-specific pricing terms.[1]
